protocol.question: Does a fixed shared cost-banded direction model add economic short value relative to its long-only mask, HOLD and existing Donchian?

labels.classes: SHORT below -37bp; LONG above +37bp; CASH otherwise; missing future stays missing

protocol.adoption: RESEARCH_ONLY: short direction retained for next independent evidence only if LONG_SHORT improves net or drawdown or realized risk-adjusted return versus LONG_ONLY in BOTH unit interpretations and BASE/STRESS. Compare HOLD/Donchian; positive short net must be separately reported. No investment qualification from 61 seen days.
protocol.stopping: ONE_FIT_20_ACCOUNTS_NO_THRESHOLD_OR_HORIZON_SEARCH; invalid inputs or budget stop preserve actual failure; recipe pauses if no conditional benefit; general short capability remains
